legal.imprint.responsible: Responsible for the content pursuant to § 18(2) MStV (German Interstate Media Treaty): {name}
legal.imprint.agency: We arrange travel services (we are not a tour operator). The contract for each service is concluded exclusively with the respective provider.
legal.imprint.dispute: We are neither willing nor obliged to participate in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration body.
legal.privacy.responsible: Controller within the meaning of the GDPR
legal.privacy.hosting: Hosting: {host}. Server logs are retained for {retention} (legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR – security and stability of the service).
legal.privacy.purposes: Purposes and legal bases: search queries and price comparisons (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR), technical operation and logs (point (f)), price alerts and emails only with consent (point (a)), statutory retention (point (c)).
legal.privacy.recipients: Recipients: hosting providers, email service providers, affiliate networks when a booking link is clicked, and the x402 facilitator for payment processing.
legal.privacy.x402: x402 payments: For a price attestation, a USDC payment is processed on a public blockchain. The wallet address, amount and transaction hash are thereby publicly and permanently visible. For accounting purposes, we additionally store invoice data (amount, date, tx hash, service).
legal.privacy.affiliate: Affiliate links: Clicking a booking link takes you to the provider, where its own privacy policy applies. We do not set our own marketing cookies.
legal.privacy.retention: Retention period: logs as set out above; invoice and accounting data in accordance with the statutory retention periods (Section 147 of the German Fiscal Code (AO), generally 8–10 years).
legal.privacy.rights: Your rights: access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability and objection (Art. 15–21 GDPR). You may withdraw any consent you have given at any time.
